I.Q Mania.name: I.Q Mania
I.Q Mania.summary: I.Q Mania is a compilation of the entire Intelligent Qube series (Intelligent Qube, I.Q Final, I.Q Remix) in one package for PSP. It also includes ad-hoc multiplayer and a new survival mode.

Queen's Blade - Spiral Chaos.name: Queen's Blade: Spiral Chaos
Queen's Blade - Spiral Chaos.summary: With the Queen's Blade Tournament ongoing, rumors arise about a dark, mysterious power threatening to destroy all of Gainos. With the new heroes, Cute and Jean, and the rest of the Queen's Blade competitors, they seek to find the root of this power and destroy it to restore balance to the land.

Taito Legends Power-Up.name: Taito Legends Power-Up
Taito Legends Power-Up.summary: Empire Interactive's Taito Legends series of compilations moved onto handheld in Europe and the US with Taito Legends Power-Up. It is slightly different from Taito's own Taito Memories Pocket, which was only released in Japan. Most notable is the inclusion of Space Invaders and Space Invaders Part 2 and the absence of Rainbow Islands Extra.

Vulcanus - Seek & Destroy.name: Vulcanus Seek and Destroy
Vulcanus - Seek & Destroy.summary: This game is a fantastic mechanical shooter, scene, 22 century, world of the future, World War II. The game is an amazing intertwining, a mixture of historical facts and fiction, players can act as mechanical robots in the legendary battles of the Second World War, such as the Battle of Leningrad, landing in Normandy.
